name: kettlebell-racked-crossover-walk
instructions:
1. Grasp a kettlebell in each hand using a neutral grip and stand up straight.
2. Clean one of the kettlebells to a racked position at shoulder height and hold the other by your side to get into position.
3. While maintaining an active shoulder position, walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
